title: review: P0c fix round 1: accepted_goals counts only GOAL tasks (role triage or goal, parent None) so an execute task carrying pr_url is never a phantom goal; tokens_per_accepted_goal and usd_per_accepted_goal stop re-scanning through efficiency() and efficiency() no longer rewrites the shared malformed-lines footer state (review T-0457)
spec:
Fix round for T-0454 (P0c v2) on its branch task/T-0454 at d64489c, addressing review T-0457 (two findings). Base goal/T-0445.
1. scorecard.accepted_goals (scorecard.py around line 600): a task is a goal candidate only when it is a GOAL task: role in ("triage", "goal") and parent is None (the GOAL tasks on this bus are role triage with parent None, e.g. T-0353, T-0445). Never add a task to goal_ids merely because it carries pr_url at top level or in result. Restore the pre-T-0454 semantics for accepted goals plus the pr_url-in-result check only for those GOAL tasks. Test: test_accepted_goals_ignores_non_goal_tasks_with_pr_url (an execute task with merged_into and pr_url is not counted; the GOAL task with pr_url in result is).
2. tokens_per_accepted_goal and usd_per_accepted_goal (around line 617): do not call efficiency(root) unconditionally. Either keep their pre-T-0454 computation from by_goal/card, or compute efficiency at most once per call and only when a goal has accepted tasks (memoise within the call; no double scan). Test: test_tokens_per_accepted_goal_scans_runs_once (monkeypatch _efficiency_rows or _read_jsonl_entries with a counter; one call to tokens_per_accepted_goal reads runs at most once) and test that its value for the fixture equals the pre-T-0454 value (the existing pinning test must still pass unchanged).
3. efficiency() and its _efficiency_rows helper must not read or write the module global _last_malformed_lines (or whatever build()/by_task() use for the CLI malformed-line footer); keep its own local malformed count and return it inside the efficiency dict under "malformed_lines". Test: test_scorecard_by_goal_footer_unaffected_by_efficiency (call efficiency() then build()/by_goal() and assert malformed_run_lines() reflects the latter's parse; and the reverse order gives the same footer).
Keep every T-0454 test and all existing tests green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; commit on task/T-0454's branch with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: accepted_goals only considers tasks with role triage or goal and parent None; efficiency() does not touch the shared malformed-lines state; tokens_per_accepted_goal reads runs at most once per call
all T-0454 tests and existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
